variation.name: bir52_fs_hkfrs_baseline
variation.description: A minimal valid financial statements iXBRL data file for a BIR52 (partnership/sole proprietorship) filing using the IRD FS Taxonomy. Revenue and ProfitLossBeforeTax are always mandatory for BIR52 (there is no consolidated-accounts exemption). TotalEquity is not required for BIR52.
